summary: This study compares the effects of two drugs, canagliflozin and pioglitazone, in patients with type 2 diabetes and nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, a condition where fat builds up in the liver. Researchers plan to enroll 80 participants aged 18 to 70 years old. The trial looks at how these treatments affect blood proteins related to cholesterol over a 24-week period.
